en: A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a military parade on a cobblestone street lined with crowds and traditional half-timbered buildings. Mounted soldiers ride in formation along tram tracks while onlookers stand densely packed on both sides of the street, many waving flags. The scene is labeled as the solemn entry of Marshal Pétain into Strasbourg on 25 November 1918, with troops parading at Pont du Faubourg National. Printed captions and credits appear at the bottom of the image.
